title: Set up Node24 server and initial PostgreSQL migration
acceptance_criteria: Verify Node24 compatibility and availability of matching Prisma 7.10.1 CLI, client and pg adapter before install; stop on incompatibility and leave the frontend toolchain unchanged.
Deliver separate ESM Fastify/Zod/pg runtime, explicit generated client configuration, one pool, graceful shutdown and request IDs with sensitive data excluded from logs.
Commit the initial owner/session/rate-limit migration and separate migration/runtime role configuration; show client generation, migrate deploy and migrate status using fresh isolated PostgreSQL.
deliverables: Server foundation, first committed migration, and real PostgreSQL migration evidence
